zh.d: 打开团队时的等待明显缩短。以 Claude Code 带队的团队为例，冷启动由约 45 秒降到 6 秒左右；再次进入通常 1 秒内完成。

zh.t: 修复：选了专家就建不了团队
zh.d: 当专家记住的模型在你当前启用的服务商里已经不存在时，创建团队会被拒绝。现在会自动改用一个可用模型，不再中断。

zh.t: 数字员工可以绑定专家和模型
zh.d: 新建和管理数字员工时可直接选择专家、运行后端与模型，同时修复了此前数字员工运行必定失败的问题。
内置 252 位各领域专家，可在设置页浏览搜索、一键添加，也能在聊天输入框和团队成员选择里直接挑选。
队友默认保持休眠，收到任务时才启动；也可以在成员卡片上手动唤醒，并查看每位成员的运行状态。

zh.t: 修复：删除的 MCP 服务仍在后台加载
zh.d: 此前在设置页删掉的 MCP 服务，曾经勾选过它的会话仍会继续加载，既拖慢启动也与预期不符。现在删除即时生效。
模型服务商被删除或改动后，团队成员启动失败时会明确告诉你该怎么处理，而不是显示一串内部编号。
新增授权码激活、成员移除与席位回收、配置备份与恢复；知识库改为混合检索并接入 Agent，检索结果更准。

zh.t: 企业与项目组界面重构
zh.d: 项目组顶层页签由 13 个收敛为 6 个，订阅用量、备份恢复等按管理范围归入企业后台，旧链接仍然可用。
文件树改为项目维度，支持展开状态记忆、搜索与预览面板，目录排在文件前面。
恢复上下文用量显示与思考计时，长链接和长路径在气泡里正确换行，权限请求面板重新设计并支持一键确认。
桌面端更新面板、发布页与官网现在共用同一份更新说明，不再各写各的。

en.d: Opening a team now takes a fraction of the time it used to. A Claude Code-led team went from about 45 seconds to roughly 6 on a cold start, and re-entering a team is usually under a second.

en.t: Fixed: picking an expert could block team creation
en.d: If an expert remembered a model that none of your enabled providers offers, creating the team was rejected. It now falls back to an available model instead of failing.

en.t: Digital employees can be bound to an expert and a model
en.d: You can now choose the expert, runtime backend and model when creating or managing a digital employee. This also fixes the error that made every digital employee run fail.
252 built-in experts across many domains. Browse and search them in Settings, add one with a single click, or pick one straight from the chat box or the team member picker.
Teammates stay dormant until work arrives. You can also wake one manually from its card and see each member's runtime state.

en.t: Fixed: deleted MCP servers kept loading
en.d: An MCP server removed in Settings was still loaded by any conversation that had previously selected it, slowing startup for no reason. Deleting one now takes effect immediately.
When a model provider has been removed or reconfigured, a teammate that fails to start now tells you what to do about it instead of showing an internal identifier.

Added license-key activation, member removal with seat reclamation, and configuration backup and restore. The knowledge base moved to hybrid retrieval and is now available to agents, improving result quality.
Top-level project-group tabs went from 13 to 6, with subscription usage and backup grouped into the enterprise console by scope. Existing links still work.
The file tree is now project-scoped, with remembered expand state, search, a preview panel, and directories sorted before files.
Context usage and thinking timers are back, long links and paths wrap correctly inside message bubbles, and the permission request panel has been redesigned with one-click approval.
The desktop update panel, the release page and the website now all read from a single source instead of maintaining separate copies.
